$comment: Size ceiling per built image, in megabytes as `docker image inspect --format {{.Size}}` reports them. `pnpm compose:boot` fails when a built image exceeds its ceiling. Measured 2026-10-22 on amd64 after the runtime stages moved to `pnpm deploy --prod` (api 454, worker 242, migrate 294, runner 3083, web 72, edge 70; before: api 2320, worker 2740, migrate 2740, runner 4680), each ceiling about 20% above the reading. The runner is large because it carries Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with their system libraries; a new dependency that doubles another image is the regression this exists to show. 2026-10-23: the runner also carries the k6 binary for the load domain (v2.3.0, 63 MB); measured on amd64 the runner went 3085 -> 3178 (+93, of which the binary is 63; /app is unchanged at 29 and the remainder was not attributed), still inside its 3700 ceiling, so the ceiling is not raised. Also 2026-10-23: `@usebruno/cli` 4.2.1 (the api domain) is a production dependency of the runner and added +301 MB measured on its own, about 250 MB of it its dependency tree; the ceiling is unchanged, and with both tools in the image it leaves little headroom, so the next tool added needs a measured case.
